verdict.rationale: Skills are plain filesystem artifacts: a folder with a SKILL.md plus optional scripts/, references/ and assets/ directories. Marketplaces can be sourced from git repos or local paths, such as the public anthropics/skills repo. So an engineering lead can inspect every instruction and script by reading the source files, but this relies on manual file and repo browsing rather than any documented review feature. Missing for 10: a documented pre-install content listing or preview in the /plugin install flow, a documented way to view or audit installed skill files from within the tool, and independent hands-on corroboration of a review workflow.
